# Historical receipt parser fixtures

These bounded projections retain secret-free receipt fields from qualification
run `39101458923` for `dariuszpanas/django-ray`, on the original commit
`85da4256b04112454228d301f2c81a959876bff4`, tree
`ed59ad1e05fad81ecdf660abc5a71e34ce30d9c2`. Original artifacts and authenticated
acquisition records remain separate and immutable. This directory is parser test
data and cannot authenticate a run or authorize qualification.

The profile `django-ray-45180ea-receipts-v1` identifies the reviewed adapter and
assertion contract at `45180ea0e47aab600ed5b77312b636c7dfdb5282`. It does not change
the source recorded by these receipts. Equal trees do not authorize relabeling
their execution commit as the merged main commit.

`context.json` has two explicit, independent observations:

| Actual attempt | Selected cells | Historical parent outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Four native recipes, latency, cancellation and monitoring | Failed |
| 2 | Application only | Passed |

Their plan, policy and binding digests are deterministic synthetic parser-fixture
identities, with a different plan digest for each selection. Producer job IDs,
actual attempts, artifact IDs, original ZIP hashes and acquisition hashes are
retained as bounded historical provenance. Tests construct synthetic trusted
caller assertions around them; the fixture JSON is never a trust source.

Every `VerifiedJob.attempt` must identify the attempt that actually executed the
original job and equal its expected observation attempt. GitHub copied-success
rows in a retry do not establish fresh execution. The seven attempt-1 results and
the one attempt-2 result cannot produce a single green full-plan attempt-2 YAGA
result. Historical aggregate acceptance remains a separate release review.

The failed application attempt-1 job and its artifact/review hashes remain in
`context.json` history. Its protected-log inventory failure has an undetermined
cause; the later passing retry does not establish a fix. Failed payloads are not
included in the accepted receipt projections.

`files.json` keeps the same 53-file allowlist. Execution manifests omit unused
dependency inventories and target summaries; application image inspection retains
only `RepoDigests` and `RootFS`. The current Core lease and RuntimeEnv maintenance
facts and native crash-cohort policy transitions are retained. Projected JSON is
encoded canonically; the before-nodes receipt remains byte-for-byte intact because
the after-nodes receipt hashes those bytes. No logs, stack traces, credentials,
environment contents, executable source or databases are included.

Never use these fixtures as proof of a live run, a complete repository gate, a
different source revision, or authenticated cross-attempt assembly.
